meta.name: excalidraw-diagram
meta.description: Create Excalidraw diagram JSON files that make visual arguments. Use when the user wants to visualize workflows, architectures, agent systems, client deliverables, or any concept as a diagram. Triggers on phrases like "draw a diagram", "make an excalidraw", "visualize this system", "diagram this flow", "map this architecture", "show me how X connects to Y".
